name: Test Channel
description: Opt-in HTTP-driven channel adapter used by integration tests to act as a real named channel. Disabled by default so it is never loaded in a production configuration.

configSchema.description: Channel key this adapter presents itself as. Set it to an existing key (for example 'telegram') to stand in for that channel in a multi-channel test.
Human-readable display name reported for this adapter.
Ring-buffer bound for captured log entries. The oldest entries are evicted once the bound is reached.
